viz_active.title: Active Attack Chains
viz_active.description: Source IPs currently across two or more attack stages.

viz_critical.title: Critical Chains
viz_critical.description: Chains that reached command and control or persistence, or scored 120 or higher.

viz_persist.title: Reached Persistence
viz_persist.description: Sources that got a web shell stage, a dropped backdoor.

viz_topsrc.title: Top Risk Sources
viz_topsrc.description: Source IPs ranked by summed risk score. Who is most dangerous right now.

viz_overtime.title: Risk Over Time
viz_overtime.description: Risk accrued per 10 minute window. Escalation is visible as it happens.

viz_progression.title: Attack Stage Progression
viz_progression.description: Which stages each active source has crossed, in attack order.

viz_notables.title: Kill Chain Notables
viz_notables.description: The COR-001 correlation output. One row per source, ranked by risk, severity escalated on command and control or persistence.

options.query:
index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval stage=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,"1-Reconnaissance",'alert.signature_id'==1000008,"2-Credential Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000002,"3-Initial Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000003,"4-Execution",'alert.signature_id'==1000006,"5-Command and Control",'alert.signature_id'==1000004,"6-Discovery",'alert.signature_id'==1000007,"7-Persistence")
| stats dc(stage) AS stages BY src_ip
| where stages>=2
| stats count AS "Active Chains"

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval stage=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,"1-Reconnaissance",'alert.signature_id'==1000008,"2-Credential Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000002,"3-Initial Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000003,"4-Execution",'alert.signature_id'==1000006,"5-Command and Control",'alert.signature_id'==1000004,"6-Discovery",'alert.signature_id'==1000007,"7-Persistence")
| eval risk=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,20,'alert.signature_id'==1000008,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000002,40,'alert.signature_id'==1000004,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000003,50,'alert.signature_id'==1000006,60,'alert.signature_id'==1000007,70)
| stats sum(risk) AS risk_score dc(stage) AS stages values(stage) AS attack_stages BY src_ip
| where stages>=2
| eval severity=case(match(mvjoin(attack_stages,","),"Persistence|Command and Control") OR risk_score>=120,"Critical", risk_score>=70,"High", true(),"Medium")
| where severity=="Critical"
| stats count AS "Critical Chains"

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval stage=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,"1-Reconnaissance",'alert.signature_id'==1000008,"2-Credential Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000002,"3-Initial Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000003,"4-Execution",'alert.signature_id'==1000006,"5-Command and Control",'alert.signature_id'==1000004,"6-Discovery",'alert.signature_id'==1000007,"7-Persistence")
| eval risk=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,20,'alert.signature_id'==1000008,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000002,40,'alert.signature_id'==1000004,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000003,50,'alert.signature_id'==1000006,60,'alert.signature_id'==1000007,70)
| stats sum(risk) AS risk_score dc(stage) AS stages BY src_ip
| where stages>=2
| stats max(risk_score) AS "Highest Risk Score"

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval stage=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,"1-Reconnaissance",'alert.signature_id'==1000008,"2-Credential Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000002,"3-Initial Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000003,"4-Execution",'alert.signature_id'==1000006,"5-Command and Control",'alert.signature_id'==1000004,"6-Discovery",'alert.signature_id'==1000007,"7-Persistence")
| stats dc(stage) AS stages values(stage) AS attack_stages BY src_ip
| where stages>=2 AND match(mvjoin(attack_stages,","),"Persistence")
| stats count AS "Reached Persistence"

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval stage=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,"1-Reconnaissance",'alert.signature_id'==1000008,"2-Credential Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000002,"3-Initial Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000003,"4-Execution",'alert.signature_id'==1000006,"5-Command and Control",'alert.signature_id'==1000004,"6-Discovery",'alert.signature_id'==1000007,"7-Persistence")
| eval risk=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,20,'alert.signature_id'==1000008,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000002,40,'alert.signature_id'==1000004,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000003,50,'alert.signature_id'==1000006,60,'alert.signature_id'==1000007,70)
| stats sum(risk) AS risk_score dc(stage) AS stages BY src_ip
| where stages>=2
| sort -risk_score
| head 10
| table src_ip risk_score

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval risk=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,20,'alert.signature_id'==1000008,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000002,40,'alert.signature_id'==1000004,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000003,50,'alert.signature_id'==1000006,60,'alert.signature_id'==1000007,70)
| timechart span=10m sum(risk) AS "Risk Score"

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval stage=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,"1-Reconnaissance",'alert.signature_id'==1000008,"2-Credential Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000002,"3-Initial Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000003,"4-Execution",'alert.signature_id'==1000006,"5-Command and Control",'alert.signature_id'==1000004,"6-Discovery",'alert.signature_id'==1000007,"7-Persistence")
| eval risk=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,20,'alert.signature_id'==1000008,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000002,40,'alert.signature_id'==1000004,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000003,50,'alert.signature_id'==1000006,60,'alert.signature_id'==1000007,70)
| stats dc(stage) AS stages_observed values(stage) AS attack_stages sum(risk) AS risk_score BY src_ip
| where stages_observed>=2
| sort -risk_score
| table src_ip stages_observed attack_stages risk_score

index=suricata sourcetype=suricata:eve event_type=alert alert.signature_id>=1000002 alert.signature_id<=1000008
| eval stage=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,"1-Reconnaissance",'alert.signature_id'==1000008,"2-Credential Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000002,"3-Initial Access",'alert.signature_id'==1000003,"4-Execution",'alert.signature_id'==1000006,"5-Command and Control",'alert.signature_id'==1000004,"6-Discovery",'alert.signature_id'==1000007,"7-Persistence")
| eval risk=case('alert.signature_id'==1000005,20,'alert.signature_id'==1000008,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000002,40,'alert.signature_id'==1000004,30,'alert.signature_id'==1000003,50,'alert.signature_id'==1000006,60,'alert.signature_id'==1000007,70)
| stats sum(risk) AS risk_score dc(stage) AS stages_observed values(stage) AS attack_stages values(alert.signature) AS detections values(dest_ip) AS targets min(_time) AS first_activity max(_time) AS last_activity BY src_ip
| where stages_observed>=2
| eval severity=case(match(mvjoin(attack_stages,","),"Persistence|Command and Control") OR risk_score>=120,"Critical", risk_score>=70,"High", true(),"Medium")
| convert ctime(first_activity) ctime(last_activity)
| sort -risk_score
| table src_ip severity risk_score stages_observed attack_stages detections targets first_activity last_activity

description: Risk based view of the custom detection set. Surfaces the COR-001 correlation, ranking source IPs by summed attack-stage risk and highlighting chains that reached command and control or persistence.
title: Risk Based Kill Chain
